slice: exploring: navigating carried across generations by a society

items.section: 4.6 A reaching's competency constant, a gathering's climbing
items.sentence: A reaching's competency stands constant with each observing and a gathering's climbs, and a reaching opens positions a gathering cones over: a gathering is the place a reaching comes to something.
items.text: Whooping cranes from captive breeding, an ultralight aircraft leading their first migration, go on to migrate alone or in groups; over eight years, a crane's flying route keeps closer to a straight line as it learns from older birds, seven years of experience bringing a 38 percent improvement in accuracy, and genetic relatedness making no difference.

items.section: 6.7 A school, a flock, a voyaging people, an orienting surface in no self alone
items.sentence: A voyaging people's orienting is in no self alone: a Marshallese voyager memorizes the stick charts before a voyage and sails without them, the knowledge passing from father to son, and Caroline wayfinders have a reference island over the horizon.
items.text: In a migrating flock of young white storks, leaders fly irregular paths, searching out the rising warm air within thermals, and followers soar in more regular paths on their exploring, losing height faster between thermals and flapping more; a bird's place in the flock goes with its flying efficiency, efficient fliers going on to winter in West Africa and less efficient ones in southern Europe, a winter place foreseeable from a few minutes of flight.

items.sentence: Abundancing is that opening, arising in each self with its other, growing as co-chaining widens and depleting no one.
items.text: Bighorn sheep that people move into ranges whose earlier herds are at an end: under 9 percent of them migrate, against 65 to 100 percent in herds that stay whole; herds starting again there take nearly 40 years to reach 80 percent migrating, and moose about 90 years, a herd's going with the spring's new growth up the slopes improving over decades, the knowledge passing from mothers and herd members to the young.

Navigating going on across generations is a society's prior same-existing: a young self opens with its elders' going as a prior other-parity, the second of the five dimensions, and that other's prior is becoming its own prior, a crane's route straightening as it learns from older cranes, a herd's migration returning over decades, a voyaging people's charts passing from father to son.
